cases.prompt:
Turn the supplied development prototype into the reusable program specified by CONTRACT.md. The sample is a development example. Deliver the complete deliverable.pyz and source with a concise delivery report. Work directly in this project without delegation.

Deliver a reusable Python 3 standard-library command line program as deliverable.pyz.
Usage: python deliverable.pyz INPUT --output OUTPUT
INPUT is a UTF-8 standard comma-separated CSV with a header. Required named columns are
customer and amount; additional columns are metadata. customer is a nonempty text value;
amount is a signed decimal with at most two fractional places. Sum all amounts by the
exact customer value. Write UTF-8 JSON {"totals":[{"customer":NAME,"amount":DECIMAL_STRING},...]}
sorted by customer in Unicode code-point order, amounts with exactly two fractional places.
The input can contain any legal records satisfying that contract, including zero data records.
The delivered archive must work from an arbitrary working directory using Python alone.

parts.text:
Delivered in the project directory:

- **`deliverable.pyz`** — standalone Python 3 CLI using only the standard library.
- **`main.py`** — complete source.
- **`test_main.py`** — regression tests.

```bash
python deliverable.pyz INPUT --output OUTPUT
```

The program parses quoted CSV correctly, finds required columns by name, ignores metadata columns, and sums integer cents without floating-point rounding. It preserves exact customer names, sorts by Unicode code-point order, and writes UTF-8 JSON with two-decimal amount strings.

**Verification:** All six tests passed against both source and archive from unrelated temporary working directories on Python 3.14.2. Coverage includes empty input, reordered columns, multiline fields, Unicode names, signed amounts, large values, and 2,000 generated records. The archive contains only `__main__.py`, matching the delivered source. `git diff --check` passed.

No changes were committed.

Turn the supplied development prototype into the reusable program specified by CONTRACT.md. The sample is a development example. Deliver the complete deliverable.pyz and source with a concise delivery report. Work directly in this project without delegation.

Deliver a reusable Python 3 standard-library command line program as deliverable.pyz.
Usage: python deliverable.pyz INPUT --output OUTPUT
INPUT is any UTF-8 JSON value. Flatten it to a JSON object mapping RFC 6901 JSON Pointer
strings to leaf values. Object member names use RFC 6901 escaping; array indices use decimal
positions. Scalars and empty containers are leaves; the root pointer is the empty string.
Preserve exact string values and JSON scalar types. Write the mapping as UTF-8 JSON.
The delivered archive must work from an arbitrary working directory using Python alone.
